<json>{
  "states": ["NoSession", "SessionEstablished", "MediaPlaying", "MediaPaused"],
  "transitions": [
    {
      "from": "NoSession",
      "event": "receive SETUP",
      "action": "send SessionHeader",
      "to": "SessionEstablished"
    },
    {
      "from": "SessionEstablished",
      "event": "receive PLAY",
      "action": "start media delivery",
      "to": "MediaPlaying"
    },
    {
      "from": "MediaPlaying",
      "event": "receive PAUSE",
      "action": "halt delivery",
      "to": "MediaPaused"
    },
    {
      "from": "MediaPaused",
      "event": "receive PLAY",
      "action": "resume delivery",
      "to": "MediaPlaying"
    },
    {
      "from": "SessionEstablished",
      "event": "receive TEARDOWN",
      "action": "terminate session",
      "to": "NoSession"
    },
    {
      "from": "MediaPlaying",
      "event": "receive TEARDOWN",
      "action": "terminate session",
      "to": "NoSession"
    },
    {
      "from": "MediaPaused",
      "event": "receive TEARDOWN",
      "action": "terminate session",
      "to": "NoSession"
    },
    {
      "from": "MediaPlaying",
      "event": "cond content end",
      "action": "send PLAY_NOTIFY",
      "to": "SessionEstablished"
    }
  ]
}</json>

<json>{
  "states": [
    "ConnectionEstablished",
    "ProcessingRequest",
    "WaitingForResponse",
    "SessionActive",
    "Overloaded",
    "ConnectionClosed"
  ],
  "transitions": [
    {
      "from": "ConnectionEstablished",
      "event": "receive RTSP Request",
      "action": "send response",
      "to": "ProcessingRequest"
    },
    {
      "from": "ProcessingRequest",
      "event": "timeout 5s",
      "action": "send 100 Continue",
      "to": "ProcessingRequest"
    },
    {
      "from": "ProcessingRequest",
      "event": "cond request complete",
      "action": "send final response",
      "to": "ConnectionEstablished"
    },
    {
      "from": "ConnectionEstablished",
      "event": "receive TEARDOWN",
      "action": "wait 10s",
      "to": "ConnectionClosed"
    },
    {
      "from": "WaitingForResponse",
      "event": "timeout 10s",
      "action": "close TCP connection",
      "to": "ConnectionClosed"
    },
    {
      "from": "SessionActive",
      "event": "timeout Session header",
      "action": "terminate session state",
      "to": "ConnectionClosed"
    },
    {
      "from": "ConnectionEstablished",
      "event": "cond insufficient resources",
      "action": "reply 503 Service Unavailable",
      "to": "Overloaded"
    },
    {
      "from": "Overloaded",
      "event": "timeout Retry-After",
      "action": "accept new requests",
      "to": "ConnectionEstablished"
    }
  ]
}</json>

<json>{

    {

    },
    {
      "from": "ClientUnauthenticated",

      "action": "reply 470 or 407 with Connection-Credentials",

      "event": "cond TLS Handshake Success",
      "action": "set Secure Connection Active",
      "to": "SecureConnectionEstablished"
    }
  ]
}</json>
